notes: Localized taxonomy v2. Each sub_category is now an object with an English key and a 'translations' map keyed by language code. The ingestion script reads the translated query for the target country's language. Country→language map: DK→da, SE→sv, NO→no, DE→de, NL→nl, BE→nl, UK→en, IE→en, US→en, FR→fr, ES→es, PT→pt, IT→it, FI→fi. Countries without a mapping fall back to English.

industries.name: Garden & outdoor furniture
industries.description: Outdoor furniture, garden accessories, BBQs, seasonal outdoor goods
industries.notes: Highly seasonal. Threshold lowered because seasonal moves can be modest in percentage terms but commercially significant.

industries.name: Women's fashion
industries.notes: High-velocity. Threshold raised because micro-trends are constant — only meaningful movements should qualify. Cap raised to allow more frequent emails.

industries.name: Men's fashion
industries.notes: Lower velocity than women's fashion. Threshold slightly lower than women's but still high.

industries.name: Beauty & skincare
industries.notes: Ingredient-driven trends move fast. TikTok and beauty blog influence is strong; RSS confirmation signal is especially valuable here.

industries.name: Beauty & makeup
industries.notes: Very TikTok-driven. Threshold high because constant noise.

industries.name: Home decor & interior
industries.notes: Moderate velocity. Editorial/design magazine influence strong; RSS confirmation valuable.

industries.name: Indoor furniture
industries.notes: Lower velocity (large purchase decisions). Cap kept conservative.

industries.name: Sports & fitness equipment
industries.description: Athletic gear, home gym, training tools
industries.notes: Event-driven (Olympics, marathons, fitness fads). January spike for resolutions, September spike for back-to-routine.

industries.name: Outdoor recreation & camping
industries.notes: Spring/summer peak. Nordic + DACH markets are core.

industries.name: Pet supplies
industries.notes: Steady demand category. Premium pet food trends emerge from health-conscious owner segments.

industries.name: Kids & baby
industries.description: Baby gear, kids' clothing, nursery, toys
industries.notes: Back-to-school spike in August. Holiday gifting spike in November-December.

industries.name: Specialty food & beverage
industries.description: Premium food, craft producers, gourmet goods
industries.notes: Gift-giving seasons important: Easter, Mother's Day, holidays. Includes Nordic specialty producers like Lakrids by Bülow.

industries.name: Wellness & supplements
industries.notes: Influencer-driven trends move fast. TikTok and YouTube health content drives many spikes.

industries.name: Tech accessories
industries.notes: Apple/Samsung product launches drive sub-category spikes. September iPhone launches especially relevant.

industries.name: Jewelry & accessories
industries.description: Fine and fashion jewelry, watches, leather goods
industries.notes: Gift-giving driven. Valentine's, Mother's Day, holidays = major peaks. Engagement ring searches peak November-December.

industries.name: Footwear — casual & sneakers
industries.notes: Sneaker culture drives strong sub-category movements. Nike/Adidas/On Running launches cause spikes.

industries.name: Lingerie & intimates
industries.notes: Valentine's Day spike. Swimwear seasonal (Mar-Aug primary).

industries.name: Stationery & office
industries.notes: Back-to-school (Aug-Sep), planner season (Nov-Jan). Mostly quiet rest of year.

industries.name: Kitchen & dining
industries.notes: Wedding registry season (spring/summer). Holiday gifting peak.

industries.name: Bath & personal care
industries.notes: Gifting season important. Natural/sustainable trends consistent.

industries.name: Hair care
industries.notes: TikTok-driven trends (rosemary oil, scalp care).

industries.name: Books & media
industries.description: Physical books, ebooks, audiobooks, learning materials
industries.notes: Lower priority — book retailers rarely use ad-creative tools heavily. Disabled by default. Re-enable if prospects appear.

industries.name: Toys & games
industries.description: Children's toys, board games, hobby goods
industries.notes: Easter (Mar-Apr) and Christmas (Oct-Dec) are the big windows.

industries.name: Bikes & cycling
industries.notes: Spring/summer peak. NL/DK/DE cycling cultures core. E-bike trend ongoing.

industries.name: Travel & luggage
industries.notes: Spring (planning summer trips) and fall (planning winter trips) are peak windows.

industries.name: Automotive accessories
industries.description: Car accessories, EV chargers, automotive lifestyle
industries.notes: Winter tires highly seasonal (Sep-Nov). EV charging trend ongoing.

industries.name: Fitness & athleisure apparel
industries.notes: January resolution spike. Pickleball/tennis trends driving recent growth.

industries.name: DIY tools & hardware
industries.description: Power tools, hand tools, hardware for home projects
industries.notes: Spring/summer DIY peak. Father's Day spike. Lower velocity overall.

industries.name: Lighting (indoor)
industries.description: Lamps, fixtures, smart lighting, decorative lighting
industries.notes: Nordic markets value lighting heavily (long winters). Smart lighting trend ongoing.

industries.name: Home Appliances
industries.description: Major and small household appliances with seasonal demand swings (cooling in summer, baking/heating in winter, post-holiday gadget surges).
industries.notes: Added 2026-06. EN + DK translations only for now; other languages to be added and spot-checked before multi-market expansion. Strong seasonal candidates: air conditioner/cooler/fan (summer), space heater/dehumidifier (winter), air fryer + baking (Q4/post-holiday).

industries.name: B2B SaaS / professional services
industries.notes: Placeholder for B2B prospects that don't fit consumer trend tracking. Trend module disabled for this segment. Other outreach mechanisms more appropriate.
